content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-146. - Safety.

            …

faqs.a:
The city is committed to a safe work environment for all employees. An employee must
               report any unsafe practice or condition to their supervisor. If an employee is injured
               on the job, no matter how minor, they must immediately report the incident in writing
               to their supervisor.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
